---
title: Montaque Reynolds, Phd
subtitle: Cover Letter
---
I am currently a visiting professor at Stetson University in Deland, FL. I defended PhD dissertation in social epistemology from Saint Louis University where I defended an account of moral testimony grounded in popular narrative. My work has been in philosophy of mind, cognitive science, and moral psychology where I focus on questions regarding the formation of human agency and personhood. 

I attribute my philosophical pedagogy to my dissertation advisor Helen De Cruz, and her work on fiction and philosophy which played an insurmountable role in my philosophical training. In addition my co-advisor Dan Haybron who’s work in value theory and happiness was a large influence on my teaching and research, as well as Eleonore Stump whose work on Thomistic virtues have been a large influence on my understanding of the importance of narrative for virtue. In my academic work, I focus broadly on narratives themselves, and what narratives can do for human moral knowledge and understanding.

I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to a learning environment that seeks to engage the student population in meaningful philosophical discourse and prepare them for a changing world. My interdisciplinary experience, and philosophical rigor combined with innovative pedagogical methods will be a terrific addition to your department. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my qualifications and the needs of your department further. Thank you for your time, and for your thoughtful consideration.
